*   **Switching Row:** A blue text link labeled "**View your channel**" sits immediately below the handle.

**3) Position of Appearance Row**
The "**Appearance: Device theme**" row is located in the middle section of the menu. Specifically, it is the **7th item** in the list (or the 4th item below the first divider), situated between "Your data in YouTube" and "Display language: English".

**4) Footer**
There is no distinct graphical footer (like a copyright notice or version number). The menu simply ends with the last two rows: "**Help**" and "**Send feedback**".

**5) Approximate Panel Geometry**
*   **Position:** The panel is anchored to the top-right corner of the viewport, dropping down from the user avatar icon.
*   **Width:** The panel is relatively narrow, occupying approximately **15% to 20%** of the total viewport width.
*   **Height:** It extends vertically to cover roughly **70% to 80%** of the viewport height, ending just above the bottom edge of the visible screen area.
